hypotheses.title: VWAP Range-Normalized Mean Reversion (10d Linear Decay)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Equities closing significantly below their volume-weighted average price (vwap - close > 0) experience institutional mean-reversion over the subsequent 1 to 5 trading days as order flow imbalances clear. Normalizing by daily true range (high - low + close * 0.0001) insulates against volatility shocks, while 10-day linear decay compresses turnover into the optimal 11%-15% sweet spot, capturing the +2.03 inverted Sharpe discovered in empirical testing.
confounders: Severe fundamental news shocks causing persistent institutional liquidation below VWAP
Wide bid-ask spreads in illiquid equities distorting closing print vs VWAP
hypotheses.falsification_test: Inverts during catastrophic macroeconomic sell-off days where gap-down selling accelerates into market close.

hypotheses.title: Intraday Bar Direction Mean Reversion (10d Linear Decay)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: In US equities, intraday momentum overshoots: securities closing higher than their open (close > open) suffer overnight and next-day price fading as day traders and fast money take profits. Buying equities that closed below their open (open - close > 0) exploits this intraday exhaustion. The inverted formulation directly converts the -1.38 Sharpe observed in Batch 176 into an expected +1.38 Sharpe with +0.97 Sub-universe Sharpe.
confounders: Strong multi-day momentum breakouts supported by institutional block buying
Pre-market earnings gaps that dictate entire day-to-day returns
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails during aggressive multi-day trend rallies where opening prints mark the intraday lows consistently.

hypotheses.title: 3-Day True-Range Multi-Day Price Displacement Reversal
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Short-term 3-day price displacements scaled by 10-day average true range isolate overextended momentum spikes. Market makers demand reversion compensation for absorbing inventory during aggressive short-term directional runs. Subindustry ranking isolates stock-specific overextension, while 8-day decay maintains optimal turnover of ~12%.
confounders: Persistent fundamental earnings drift following major guidance raises
M&A buyout rumors preventing post-spike mean reversion
hypotheses.falsification_test: Inverts during structural momentum regime shifts where 3-day winners continue accelerating.
